smartDecision.whyNow: General Posting Setup is still a Foundation blocker, but repeated Page 314 cell-edit attempts have not produced a trusted route. A local source/configuration decision is the smallest safe next step.
smartDecision.risk: Choosing another UI write route without source/configuration evidence would repeat the same blocker and may create partial setup data.
smartDecision.fallback: Keep Page 314 parked and continue with VAT or Dimensions only under explicit blocker boundaries.

No Business Central write is performed in this decision case.
